findings.problem: Add contour silently fails after native-curve editing and selects a nonexistent contour.
findings.fix: Append the new straight contour to the authoritative native source; preserve old handles, selection and one history step.
findings.tests: trace-store.test.ts: adds a contour after native-curve editing without losing handles or history

findings.problem: Native-curve and unselected-ring point edits can split one shared retained hole into duplicate exclusions.
findings.fix: Infer changed authored holes from the previous geometry and synchronize all references for both representations.
findings.tests: trace-store.test.ts: shared-hole curve tests with/without prior native source, cyclic/reversed references, point selection without a selected ring, Undo/Redo and one Trace-to-Bin hole

findings.problem: A missing touch-up after focus/source interruption leaves a stale touch ID and later touches stuck in pinch mode.
findings.fix: Cancel the gesture and clear touch tracking on focus/resize/source/editor reset.
findings.tests: use-curve-editor.test.tsx: fresh touch after blur and source replacement without an old pointerup

findings.problem: Recovery treats an explicitly null historical calibration as absent, sampling an earlier curve with the current ruler.
findings.fix: Use the historical calibration, including null; inherit the current ruler only for legacy frames without photo metadata.
findings.tests: trace-draft.test.ts: recover an uncalibrated native-curve frame after later calibration, then Undo

findings.problem: In a synthetic weak-background case, automatic sensitivity absorbs a small independent tool while recovering a larger neighbor.
findings.fix: Compute source support relative to the smaller evidence region so independently supported small objects retain the merge veto.
findings.tests: adaptive-edges.test.ts: preserve a separate 5x5 tool; still recover small color islands already enclosed by one tool

browser.scope: Two original JPEGs, actual compiled Chrome UI, recommended paper perspective + aid/paper scale, point and native curve repair, Add contour after native simplification with Undo/Redo. Desktop and 390px viewport; no real-phone performance claim.

corpus.scope: 36 actual tool photos on white Pocketry calibration sheets / 90 views, including the two exact browser controls. Excludes eight tray/packaging/mixed-tray contexts.
corpus.method: One fresh quality-only run of the current pipeline per view using identical RGBA bytes, occlusions, tolerance, smoothing=1 and Auto sensitivity=128; compare the dense and displayed outlines with stored pre-review Auto outputs. Input SHA-256 verified before each run.
corpus.performance: No new timing benchmark; previous paired timings are retained.

limits: No physical-phone timing or physical-fit qualification
The earlier selected 78 CAD/export qualification tests were not repeated for these detection guards, editing and recovery changes
Existing Wiha-group fragmentation, missed features and other corpus limitations remain
githubCi: Local verification only. Hosted CI remains disabled; no CI workflow enabled or dispatched.
provenance: None added or changed: no dependencies, copied code, model/runtime assets or license obligations introduced by this follow-up.
